CoolerItem.title: CoolerItem
CoolerItem.description: A beverage item and price displayed on the 777 Liquor Cooler Door menu.

name.description: Normalized product name following 777 Liquor capitalization rules (e.g., Heineken Lager 12pk 12oz Bottles).

brand.description: Normalized alcohol brand name linked to public/images/brands.

size.description: Normalized pack or container size (e.g., 12pk 12oz, 1 L, 750ml).

description.description: Optional tasting notes or product description.

abv.description: Optional alcohol by volume label (e.g., 5.0% ABV).

origin.description: Optional region or country of origin (e.g., Honolulu, HI).

visibility.description: Visibility state for public storefront menu queries.

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who last updated the item.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when this item was created or last modified.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Trusted store administrator record granting Cooler Door inventory management privileges.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

KegInquiry.title: KegInquiry
KegInquiry.description: Customer keg pre-order inquiry stored privately per user and readable by store admins.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the customer who submitted the inquiry.

notes.description: Optional event date, keg size, or pump rental notes.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the keg inquiry.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the inquiry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the inquiry was last updated.

/coolerItems/{itemId}.description: Publicly readable Cooler Door beverage catalog and pricing managed exclusively by verified store administrators.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Trusted administrator lookup documents isolating admin PII to the owner and bootstrapped store owner.

/kegInquiries/{inquiryId}.description: Private customer keg pre-order inquiries accessible only by the submitting user and store administrators.
